Introduction

be performed every 
six monthes 
as indicated by M6 in the title block.

Mazout Storage tank re-circulating Pump 
CB324A-300 
function:
Drawing 
the Mazout through the heater and pumps it to the top of main tank.

The first draft initiated by eng. Emad El din Ali Abd Alla, accepted by eng. Mokhtar Abdel Latef general director, revised by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd El Latif 
Abu Soltan power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection 
& quality 
control head sector.
Technical Specification
Mazout Storage Tank
Falk 60 T
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks must be surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker for motor of this pump.

Isolate the electrical 
 cable bearing of the motor of this pump

The pump 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves 
 and drain it.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid, and
 suitable lifting device,
Manual puller, feeler gauge.
Lessen set screws, and grease.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Check the direction of the Pump

Be sure there is no any abnormal noise or 
 vibration and prevent it if found

Be sure there is no any leakage from any 
 Gasket and prevent it if found.
Check pressure in delivery of the pump.
Check quantity delivered of the pump.
Check the temperature of bearing house

sections.text:
Before Isolating the Pump Mechanically and 
Electrically

items: Check any noise or vibration in pump.
Check the direction of the motor rotation.
Check leakage from any gasket.
Check pressure in delivery of the pump's delivery.
Check the temperature of bearing.

sections.text:
After Isolating the Pump Mechanically and 
Electrically

items:
Check the impeller and casing from mechanical wear and measure the 
 clearances by dismantle the Pump.
Check the bearing in the Pump.
Prevent the leakage from gasket by renewed it.
Check the coupling's gear and change grease of coupling.
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation.
Check the alignment between pump and motor.

sections.text: Operation of the Pump

items:
Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK and check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
